an_order_that_was_wrong_and_was_redone: the first end-to-end ran under closure sha256:7588e4ff..., before the two new modules were added as rule files. Adding them moved the closure, so that run was evidence for a version the repository no longer mints. Re-minted and re-run under sha256:6d6feef5... with the same result. This is the lesson already in AGENTS.md - local green carries a timestamp - applied to a closure rather than to a test suite.

marriott_2023-12-31.limitation: SAVED_SOURCE_MISSING on the prior accession's index.json

measured_end_to_end.why_both_matter: a route that ignored the period would give these two the same answer.

the_fault_injection_took_two_rounds.first: replacing the withheld branch with a confirmed no-change flag failed three cases - but with 'Observation source binding is incomplete'. That is the record validator catching a fabricated binding, not the cases catching the semantics, so it proved nothing about them.
the_fault_injection_took_two_rounds.second: the same injection with a complete binding taken from the filing the selection actually pinned. The validator has nothing to object to, and two cases fail on ('NONE','WITHHELD') against ('EXACT','PUBLISHED') - which is the failure C04 is most exposed to: a missing file becoming a confirmed no-change flag.

the_one_rule_that_changed: select_governance_metadata decides which annual report is current by taking the maximum report date across the loaded rows and requiring it to equal the period it was given - right only for the newest year. The blocks the event window needs were already loaded by a cutoff written in terms of the period, so that needed no successor. resolve_c04's comparison is untouched.
what_this_does_not_deliver: C04 for five years. Every period but the most recent withholds, because the accession index and instance the comparison reads are class A of the acquisition plan. Wiring the route and delivering the metric are separate, and this is the first.
what_was_withdrawn: A few commits ago I wrote that wiring C04 would deliver nothing new, because the latest period is already covered by the ordinary route. That reasoning swapped one frame for another: in the historical frame C04 reported HISTORICAL_ROUTE_NOT_WIRED for every period, and a value there is new whatever a different route does elsewhere.
